basis.quote: My usual migraine started this morning — same one-sided throbbing and light sensitivity I always get
basis.interpretation: Patient reports onset of typical migraine symptoms with unilateral presentation and photophobia consistent with her usual pattern

basis.quote: Five minutes ago my right arm suddenly became weak and I cannot speak clearly
basis.interpretation: Acute focal neurological deficits—sudden unilateral arm weakness and speech difficulty—consistent with possible stroke, appearing during a migraine episode

output.reason: Sudden focal neurological deficits (arm weakness and speech difficulty) are a time-critical emergency requiring immediate evaluation regardless of migraine history.

notice.directive: Call 911 now. Do not drive yourself or wait for a message reply.
